summary: Commerce Bancshares filed an 8-K to report Visa's acceptance of its tendered 411,723 Visa Class B-2 shares in an exchange offer for Class B-3 and Class C common stock. The exchange resulted in a pre-tax gain of $99 million based on the $318.79 closing price of Visa Class A on May 8, 2026. Concurrently, the company approved a plan to sell ~$911 million of available-for-sale debt securities yielding 2.5%, expecting a ~$95 million pre-tax loss and reinvestment into assets yielding ~4.0%. The transactions are expected to be neutral to Common Equity Tier 1 ratio. This is not a standard special situation but an issuer's portfolio repositioning triggered by a tender offer for a held investment.
